verdict.rationale: Opting out of product telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of any setting to disable vendor usage data collection. The 'telemetry' mentions refer to customer observability data ingestion (OpenTelemetry), not vendor tracking of users, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
